Influent wastewater flows into Pond 1, a lined facultative pond where it undergoes aerobic processing of organic substances near the surface.
Settled sludges undergo anaerobic fermentation in the anaerobic lower region of the pond.
Effluent is pumped from Pond 1 into Pond 2, a Primary and facultative pond for further treatment before being land applied through spray irrigation.

The wastewater disposal methods include land applying onto 47.6 acres and evaporation/percolation via 64.4 acre-feet of basins.
Solids are removed every five to eight years using a solids waste hauler.
In the notice of intent, Los Alamos Community Services District proposes that the Wastewater System is designed to treat and dispose of 200,000 gallons per day to a secondary treatment level.
